bug_semantics: Stored DOM XSS in the Fancy Text widget: a contributor-controlled animation/transition token is persisted in Elementor widget settings, rendered as data-fancy-text-transition-type, read by frontend JS, and concatenated into Morphext's innerHTML as a CSS class (`<span class="animated " + animation + ">`). Quote-breaking payloads close that attribute and inject markup/event handlers that run for every later visitor. The editor SELECT list is not enforced server-side; the 2026 fix also notes a ShortCode-widget HTML path. Phrase text had been DOMPurify-sanitized earlier; the animation token was not.
flaw_origin: 2018-07-23 commit 3a2ff8f2c42b63e60c2a17fb3657070db2f6e70c (abdulhalimmanik, 'Fancy text updated') first wrote the unsanitized data-attribute plumbing that makes the animation token attacker-controlled in the decoded-DOM sense: PHP add_render_attribute('data-fancy-text-transition-type', $settings['eael_fancy_text_transition_type']) plus a new FancyText handler that passes jQuery .data() straight into Morphext({animation: $transition_type}). The parent still used an inline-script Morphext call with PHP esc_attr() inside a JavaScript string, so HTML metacharacters did not survive into the innerHTML class concatenation. The innerHTML sink itself is vendored Morphext (present since git root 1fed842907a265541bd6ca0562b349ee62643495, 2017-07-19) and later only moved/pretty-printed; that vendor copy is not the BIC.

reasoning: CVE-2026-15145 is a real published Wordfence CWE-79 in Fancy Text: contributor-stored animation names reach Morphext innerHTML without allowlisting or escaping. The complete 2026 attack path is data-fancy-text-transition-type → jQuery.data → Morphext settings.animation → innerHTML class concatenation. git log -S / parent greps show that path was first written in 3a2ff8f2c42b63e60c2a17fb3657070db2f6e70c; the immediate parent still emits animation only through esc_attr() inside an inline JavaScript string, so the decoded-DOM innerHTML breakout is absent there. Later asset splits and the unminified morphext.js extract only moved that wiring. The 2026 fix is the smallest closer of both source (allowlist) and sink (createElement/textContent) and lands in 6.7.0, after affected 6.6.11.
